ruleDefinitions.name: RDP Connection Allowed Via Netsh.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the netsh command to open and allow connections to port 3389 (RDP). As seen used by Sarwent Malware

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\netsh\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "netsh\.exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*firewall\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*tcp\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*3389.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*portopening.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*allow.*"))))
